assets.edition: United States, original K-A, NUS-NSME, copyright 1996
limitations: Duotone edge illustrations are source-based reconstructions with approximate placement and ink colors, not newly discovered flat original scans.
Nintendo Classics front source remains 1548 × 1080 pixels; original rear comes from the 4170 × 2916 scan.
Small jump illustration is 330 × 330 pixels; enlargement cannot add source detail.
Replacement typography, seal/recycle geometry and warm background repairs are visual approximations, not calibrated factory print.
assets.restorationMethod: Clean original K-A front retained. Exact original rear promotional/legal wording re-typeset after bounded ink removal; original five screenshots and gold background retained. Clean screenshot frames, valid UPC-A with original digits, reconstructed quality/recycling marks and period Nintendo capsule. Four edge duotones reconstructed from original period character renders, preserving the documented title/badge layout and template orientation. No generated imagery.

assets.edition: United States, early round seal, no REV-A, five-screw-era hangtab box
limitations: Restored composite, not an untouched factory print or complete new scan.
Front title, Nintendo and console wordmark shapes are traced from original print, not substitute typefaces. Contour smoothing removes optical roughness; colors are visual estimates.
Round seal border is reconstructed; exact original wording uses approximate Arial Narrow Bold while the Nintendo capsule preserves original glyph contours.

Mario/block illustration uses fitted flat ink colors and polygonal contours from the original print. This restores its pixel-art appearance rather than recovering new scan detail. Fine speed lines and original rear CRT screenshots remain optical source imagery.
Earlier documented edge address/warranty typeface remains an approximation.
assets.restorationMethod: Higher-detail original-print component substitution and subpixel-smoothed original letter contours. Front title and console glyphs are rectified for all three printed narrow panels, retaining the documented layout. Front and rear round seals use original Nintendo glyphs and exact wording in approximate Arial Narrow Bold. Original rear CRT screenshots remain; flat fresh black fields exclude abrasion. Mario/block ink regions are restored to a fitted 14-color palette with straight polygon contours, preserving the angular pixel silhouette, original blue offsets and protected fine speed lines; no invented illustrated detail.

assets.edition: United States, black label, SNS P MW, copyright 1992
limitations: Digital reconstruction, not an untouched original scan or a factory-calibrated print.
Colors, replacement typography, quality-seal geometry and gray stripe motif are visual approximations.
Original rear screenshots remain limited by the 1143 × 800 source; the original Dry Bones artwork is 429 × 438 pixels.
4K preparation improves raster output and fresh typed/vector details; it does not create new source illustration information.
assets.restorationMethod: Native-resolution edge-preserving halftone removal preserves original front and edge character contours. Complete rear promotional/legal text re-typeset with exact original wording; original four printed screenshots retained. Clean title, valid UPC-A with original digits, reconstructed quality/recycling marks, period Nintendo capsule and flat ink fields. Front tiny green TM re-typeset explicitly. No generated imagery.
assets.editionEvidence: The retained front and original rear share the US black-label layout; rear retains copyright 1992, SNS P MW, UPC 045496830014, original four printed screenshots and North American legal copy. Original side specimen photographs establish the different flying/diving poses and the original Nintendo of America address.

assets.edition: European Mega Drive, cream/pink grid, 670-1470-50S, copyright 1991
limitations: Original Sonic title and type contours are traced into antialiased flat ink; the decorative grid is measured and redrawn. These are restored approximations, not recovered factory vectors.
Chrome Mega Drive plate silhouette and silver/gold reflection bands are reconstructed from the documented original logo; the archived clean SEGA wordmark supplies the logo lettering.

Original shaded Sonic illustration and four rear screenshots retain source-resolution limits. Pink/cream paper fields and black fields are cleaned independently of character shading. Colors are visually estimated, not calibrated.
assets.restorationMethod: Deterministic contour tracing, bounded original illustration denoise, clean solid/grid fields, documented chrome-plate reconstruction and clean archived SEGA vector. Mega Drive template 0.2.0 corrects the original mirrored spine UV.

assets.edition: United States, SCUS-94900, original black label K-A, standard clear-tray jewel case
limitations: The original four-part SCUS-94900 K-A set and all game illustrations remain. Matching classic 1994 wordmarks replace only worn console branding.
NTSC U/C and TM copy is reproduced exactly using approximate Arial Bold, not a verified original production font.

Original rear copy and screenshot detail remain source-limited; output enlargement does not recover new photographic detail. Printed inner ribbed design remains artwork; only unprinted outside trim loses crease glare. Colors are visual estimates.
assets.restorationMethod: Deterministic non-local scan-grain filtering, gentler treatment of fine rear legal copy, matching 1994 Sony-manual-derived vector wordmarks, exact NTSC U/C and TM copy in approximate Arial Bold, original spine glyph contours and bounded dark-field normalization. No generative artwork or geometry/material changes.
